root_cause: The readiness probe points at the aggregate /actuator/health endpoint, which includes the Redis health indicator, with timeoutSeconds: 1 and failureThreshold: 1. During the Redis node migration Redis latency spiked, the health endpoint took >1s, and pods were marked NotReady and removed from the Service endpoints in bursts, producing 503 no healthy upstream. The recommendation-widget errors are a pre-existing, unrelated issue.
